commands.title: Delete All Skins
commands.description: Removes applied skins from pals and structures, and clears each player's stored skin inventory. Skins are cosmetic, so nothing else about the save changes.

commands.title: Delete Imported Pals
commands.description: Removes every pal flagged as DNA-imported, from the world and from each player's dimensional storage, and clears the container slots that referenced them.

commands.title: Delete Empty Guilds
commands.description: Removes guilds that have no remaining members.

commands.title: Delete Inactive Players
commands.description: Removes players who have not logged in for the given number of days. Guild admins are never removed.

commands.title: Fix Future Timestamps
commands.description: Clamps last-online timestamps that sit in the future back to the world's current time. Does not update the duplicate copy of the timestamp stored in guild membership data.

commands.title: Remove Invalid Pals
commands.description: Removes pals whose species is not in the game's pal catalog, from the world and from each player's dimensional storage. Bosses, lucky pals and predators are kept, since their ids carry a prefix the catalog does not list.

commands.title: Remove Invalid Items
commands.description: Clears item stacks whose item id is not in the game's item catalog.

commands.title: Remove Invalid Passive Skills
commands.description: Removes passive skills that are not in the game's passive-skill catalog, from pals in the world and in each player's dimensional storage.

commands.title: Delete Duplicated Players
commands.description: Where one player has more than one character record, keeps the most recently online one and removes the others. Guild membership records are left as they are.

commands.title: Delete Inactive Bases
commands.description: Removes bases whose guild members all fail the chosen filter -- inactive for the given number of days, below a level, or both. A base whose guild has no readable members is left alone rather than treated as inactive. A member whose save file is not in this bundle is invisible to this command, and a member uid that belongs to more than one guild counts toward only one.

commands.title: Delete Structures Outside Bases
commands.description: Removes structures that belong to no base camp, along with the work entries that referenced them.

commands.title: Delete Invalid Structures
commands.description: Removes structures whose type is not in the game's building catalog, along with the work entries that referenced them. Treasure boxes, resource nodes and dropped items are kept.

commands.title: Delete Unreferenced Data
commands.description: Removes pals that no container holds, work entries whose structure is gone, and stored item data nothing refers to, and clears structure references to players who are no longer in the save. Guild membership records are left as they are.
